installId.description: Random install id, no account needed.

capturedAt.description: ISO time the event happened in-game.

name.description: The encounter's name in the client's language. Public only when 3 installs agree on it.

instanceMapId.description: The instance's map id, the 8th return of `GetInstanceInfo`: a map, not a UiMap.

difficulty.description: The difficulty id `GetInstanceInfo` reports. Absent when the source did not record it.

size.description: The group size the encounter reports.

success.description: True for a kill, false for a wipe.

npcIds.description: The bosses' creature ids the client listed for the encounter, or the creatures that died in it. Absent when there were none.

startedAt.description: When `ENCOUNTER_START` fired for this pull. Absent when the addon did not see the start (older addons, a client restarted mid-fight).

durationSeconds.description: Whole seconds from `ENCOUNTER_START` to `ENCOUNTER_END`. Present only with `startedAt`.

runId.description: The `instance_run` this pull belongs to. Absent when the addon had no run open.

description: Everloot upload record: encounter. The server also checks: startedAt and durationSeconds come together.
